brief:
A fourteen-year-old boy named Fuad woke at dawn on Saturday to prepare for school at his father's house in Gaza. He would soon learn that Israeli airstrikes had killed his Christian mother and sister, according to Middle East Eye.

The killings occurred amid ongoing Israeli military operations in the territory, affecting Gaza's Christian population alongside others caught in the conflict.
dek: ‘The Israeli occupation does not distinguish’: Gaza family mourns Christian mother and daughter Fourteen-year-old Fuad woke up at around 5am on Saturday at his father’s house to get ready for school.
title: Israeli strikes kill Christian mother and daughter in Gaza
